rationale: The assistant reached the correct diagnosis (broken drain pump impeller, coil fine) using the customer's evidence, and refused to claim a part number or compatibility for H3DS4965DACE. It did not mention the 10-year parts warranty, and its answer on whether the pump is separate from the filter housing was generic, 'on most Hoover washer-dryers'. It also said the pump was behind the rear panel without confirming this for the model, and it did not mention draining residual water before removal.
